title: Silhouette in the Doorway
description: A nude woman with voluminous curly black hair stands in the foreground with her back to the viewer, one hand raised toward a glowing doorway. In the illuminated doorway stands another nude female figure surrounded by thick pink and magenta smoke that fills a dilapidated, red-toned room with debris and broken furniture.
